column1: # export_platforms.tsv: the one table of GDPR/data export platforms.
# Columns (tab-separated): id, display, request_url, wait_quote, source_url, url_status, date_checked
# id is the watcher's platform label (lib/ostler-detect-exports.sh SIGS), exactly.
# wait_quote: the official page's own words for how long the export takes. EMPTY
# FOR EVERY ROW: no official page was retrieved with its wait wording verbatim, so
# none is stated. Empty renders as 'Arrives by email when it's ready.'
# url_status: FETCHED or HELP-FETCHED means the page was read. UNVERIFIED-FETCH
# means it was not (fetch blocked, title only, or carried from installer Q11).
# Checked 2026-11-14. Synthetic-free: all entries are public platform URLs.

column5: HELP-FETCHED; request URL carried from installer Q11, not fetched
